## [[Badge(R)s?!?]{.englebert}](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-badge/)[[...we don't need no stinking badge(R)s!!!]{.englebert}](https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/badger)

::: {.panel-tabset}

### {{< iconify material-icon-theme:quarto >}} extension {{< iconify carbon:tool-kit >}}

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="40%"}

```{r}
extensions:
  badge:
    badges:
      - key: stable
        colour: dodgerblue
      - key: kulas
        colour: "#bada55"
        icon: alarm
        href: https://www.google.com/
        target: _blank
        title: This is a popup message (upon cursor hover) 
```

:::

::: {.column width="60%"}

Renders [customized pills](https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-badge/):

```{r}
This is stable Version {{< badge stable 1.1 >}}
This is Kulas Version {{< badge kulas 0.2.2 >}}
```


:::

:::

![](/img/badges.JPG){.absolute right="40" bottom="10"}

![](https://freepngimg.com/save/129581-badger/400x524){.absolute bottom="150" right="-170" height="300"}

### {{< iconify devicon:r >}} package {{< iconify fluent-emoji-flat:package >}}

::: {.columns}

::: {.column width="5%"}
:::

::: {.column width="50%"}

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| echo: false
library(badger)
```


Grabs [package meta--data](https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/badger):

```{r}
library(badger)

`ggplot2`: `r badge_cran_release("ggplot2", "orange")`  

Downloads:  
  + Last week: `r badge_cran_download("ggplot2", "last-week", "green")`  
  + Last month: `r badge_cran_download("ggplot2", "last-month", "green")`  
  + All time: `r badge_cran_download("ggplot2", "grand-total", "green")`

```
:::

::: {.column width="45%"}


`ggplot2`: `r badge_cran_release("ggplot2", "orange")`  

+ Last week: `r badge_cran_download("ggplot2", "last-week", "green")`  
+ Last month: `r badge_cran_download("ggplot2", "last-month", "green")`  
+ All time: `r badge_cran_download("ggplot2", "grand-total", "green")`
